rules: Generate state and code_verifier with cryptographically secure randomness for every authorization session.
Validate callback state exactly before exchanging the authorization code.
Bind callback server to loopback only on port 60355.
Never log authorization code, code_verifier, registration_access_token, access_token or refresh_token.
Persist only non-secret client_id metadata in the gitignored .moomoo-auth directory.
After token exchange, pass access_token only through the child-process environment to the governed first-live-import script.
Do not persist refresh_token in P2-P2A; re-authorize for a later session until a dedicated secure credential-store contract exists.
Trading and account endpoints remain prohibited.
The callback listener must be confirmed listening before the authorization page is opened.
On Windows, browser launch uses PowerShell Start-Process so ampersands in the OAuth query string are not interpreted by cmd.exe.
The helper must print WAITING_FOR_BROWSER_AUTHORIZATION and remain alive until callback, timeout or explicit authorization failure.
Authorization URL explicitly requests the minimum scope quote:read.
Token exchange must return quote:read; a token containing trade:write is rejected by this helper.
